title: Bouncy Ball Pit
description: Create a scene with a ball that bounces off walls and floor using Physics Materials and Rigidbody.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Set up a simple physics environment with a bouncing ball.

1. Create a new scene. Add a Plane (scale it to (2,1,2)) for the floor.
2. Create four Cubes around as walls (scale them to form a box). Remove their Box Colliders and add one combined Box Collider per wall, or just use the existing ones. Ensure walls have colliders but no Rigidbody (static).
3. Create a Sphere and add a Rigidbody. Set Drag to 0, Angular Drag to 0.1, Use Gravity = true.
4. Create a Physics Material (Project window → Create → Physics Material). Name it "Bouncy". Set Bounciness to 0.8, Bounce Combine to Maximum, Friction to 0.
5. Assign the "Bouncy" material to the Sphere's Collider.
6. Play. The sphere should bounce around due to gravity.
7. Experiment: change Bounciness to 1 and see the difference; then to 0.
8. (Optional) Add a script that applies a random force on Start to get things moving.

Take a screenshot of the Scene view showing the ball mid‑air and the Inspector showing the Physics Material.
hints: Make sure the walls are static (no Rigidbody) so they don't move.
If the ball doesn't bounce, check that the Plane and walls have colliders.
Try increasing the sphere's Rigidbody Collision Detection to Continuous Dynamic if it tunnels through walls.
expectedOutput: Sphere bounces realistically off surfaces. Screenshot shows Physics Material settings.
